digest.component_or_area: LLM framework trigger system, code-review routing
propositions: The rebar project requires noisy-tier concurrency vocabulary tokens (.lock, retry, Popen, fork, etc.) to trigger on 22% of diffs in addition to the committed 13.3%, because three corpus bugs are detectable only through noisy-tier vocabulary
The two-layer trigger design (committed high-precision tier + project noisy tier) must be documented in docs/llm-framework.md with measurement methodology and the rebar entry as worked example

Project-level trigger vocabulary extensions are added to .rebar/criteria_routing.json via the code_review.concurrency overlay using trigger_tokens and applies_to keys that merge over committed routing
Config-effect testing must verify that a diff with index.lock fires the concurrency overlay under rebar's effective routing but not under committed-only routing
